SELECT DATE(c.input_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM car_input c WHERE c.deleted = 0
AND c.input_time BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime}) AND FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND c.area_id = #{reqVO.areaId}
GROUP BY DATE(c.input_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT c.id AS id, c.plate_no AS plateNo, c.space_id AS spaceId, s.space_no AS spaceNo, c.input_time AS inputTime, c.status AS status, c.area_id AS areaId, a.name AS areaName, c.input_user_id AS inputUserId, u1.nickname AS inputUserName, c.audit_user_id AS auditUserId, u2.nickname AS auditUserName, c.audit_time AS auditTime, c.audit_comment AS auditComment, c.remark AS remark, c.reserve1 AS reserve1, c.reserve2 AS reserve2, c.creator AS creator, c.updater AS updater, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime FROM car_input c LEFT JOIN area_info a ON c.area_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_info u1 ON c.input_user_id = u1.id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_info u2 ON c.audit_user_id = u2.id AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN parking_space_info s ON c.space_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0
